theme.title: Down 3–1
theme.subtitle: 2016 Finals, Cleveland vs Golden State
theme.recap: Cleveland won the last three games, with LeBron James and Kyrie Irving scoring 41 each in Game 5 and the two teams dead level on points before Game 7.

questions.prompt: In Game 5 of the 2016 Finals, LeBron James and Kyrie Irving each scored how many points?
questions.context: 2016 NBA Finals · Game 5 · at Golden State
questions.note: 41 apiece, the first teammates to both reach 40 in a Finals game.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: James and Irving each scored 41 points to become the first teammates in Finals history to score 40 or more

funFacts.text: Draymond Green missed the game through suspension after a flagrant foul against LeBron.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Green was suspended for Game 5

funFacts.text: Green watched the contest from a luxury box in the Oakland Athletics' stadium.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Green watched the game from a luxury box in the nearby Oakland Alameda Coliseum

funFacts.text: Cleveland was facing elimination after Golden State had taken three of the first four games.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Warriors won three of the first four games and led 3–1

questions.prompt: What was LeBron James's scoring average in the 2016 Finals, when he was named MVP?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: after averaging 29.7 points, 11.3 rebounds, 8.9 assists, 2.6 steals, and 2.3 blocks.

funFacts.text: LeBron also averaged 11.3 rebounds and 8.9 assists per game in that series.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: averaging 29.7 points, 11.3 rebounds, 8.9 assists, 2.6 steals, and 2.3 blocks

funFacts.text: He became the first player to lead an entire Finals series in points, rebounds, assists, steals and blocks.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: lead all players in a playoff series in points, rebounds, assists, steals, and blocks

funFacts.text: Every Finals MVP voter picked LeBron after Cleveland's comeback title.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: LeBron James was unanimously voted the NBA Finals Most Valuable Player

questions.prompt: Draymond Green led all scorers in Game 7 of the 2016 Finals. How many points did he score?
questions.note: 32, more than anyone else that night.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Draymond Green put up his best performance of the Finals, leading all scorers with 32 points,

funFacts.text: Green shot an outstanding six of eight from beyond the arc in the final game.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: including 6-of-8 from three-point range

funFacts.text: His stat line also included 15 rebounds and nine assists.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: along with 15 rebounds and nine assists

funFacts.text: Kyrie Irving added 26 points for Cleveland during the decisive game.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Kyrie Irving added 26 points for Cleveland

questions.prompt: Coach Steve Kerr missed how many games at the start of 2015–16 with a back injury?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Steve Kerr missed the first 43 regular season games because of a back injury.

funFacts.text: Assistant Luke Walton ran the Warriors while Kerr recovered and guided them to a blistering 39–4 start.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Assistant coach Luke Walton served as interim head coach during Kerr's absence and he led the Warriors to a 39–4 start

funFacts.text: Golden State opened the season with 24 consecutive wins.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: best start to a season (24–0)

funFacts.text: Stephen Curry and Klay Thompson combined to average 52.2 points per game that regular season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: combining to average 52.2 points per game

questions.prompt: Before Game 7 of the 2016 Finals, both teams had scored the exact same total over six games. What was it?
questions.context: 2016 NBA Finals · Games 1–6 · Cavaliers and Warriors

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: both teams entered Game 7 with the same total points scored through six games (610 points each).

funFacts.text: Cleveland won the final game 93–89, with 20 lead changes and 11 ties.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Cavaliers defeated the Warriors 93–89 in Game 7

funFacts.text: LeBron's chase-down block on Andre Iguodala came with the score tied late in Game 7.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: LeBron James delivered what became known as "The Block"

funFacts.text: The Warriors went the final four minutes and 39 seconds without a made basket.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: failed to score a basket during the last 4:39 of the game
